name: loft-frustum
why: The loft op against a closed form: ruled walls between a 40 and a 20 mm square 30 mm apart are a prismatoid, V = 30/6*(1600+3600+400) = 28000 mm3 and A = 5794.73 mm2, both exact. The implicit half is the op's contract: no exact distance field exists for a loft, so it must refuse by name and point at the B-rep backend, never approximate.
